Regarding the physical therapy plan for lateral epicondylitis (tennis elbow), the described techniques are generally considered effective and align with current clinical guidelines. Eccentric strengthening exercises for the wrist extensors are a cornerstone of conservative management for this condition, as they help remodel collagen and improve tendon load tolerance. Manual therapy can assist in reducing pain and improving tissue mobility, while ice therapy is appropriately used post-exercise to manage acute inflammation and pain. This multimodal approach addresses both the mechanical dysfunction and the inflammatory component of the injury.
